name: How much does it cost to upgrade kitchen electrical outlets and switches?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade kitchen electrical outlets and switches?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to upgrade kitchen electrical outlets and switches varies based on the number of devices, accessibility, and whether new circuits are needed. Basic replacements are less expensive than adding new outlets or upgrading to specialty options like pop-up outlets or USB charging ports. A decision factor is whether you only want to replace existing components or also expand functionality; adding convenience features like USB outlets or moving existing outlets will increase complexity and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost to upgrade kitchen outlets/switches varies by quantity, accessibility, and new circuit needs. Adding features or new locations increases cost.
